title: Concept Design with 3D Facade Visualization | DUMSKAYA
description: Architectural concept design with 3D visualization of facades and surroundings: massing, materials and landscaping. Studio in Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Concept design with 3D visualization of building facades and surroundings

blocks.text: Concept design with 3D visualization of building facades and surroundings

parts.html: For this house, DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed a concept design for the facade in budget and premium versions, as well as landscaping that blends the house into its surroundings.
Affordable yet high-quality materials and minimalist decor: the result is a contemporary, neat, and functional facade.

Plants were selected based on an analysis of the site, and the pathways are made of inexpensive yet durable materials. The landscaping highlights the natural surroundings and stays within a limited budget.
The finishes are natural stone, premium plaster, and wood paneling. Exclusive decorative elements make the facade elegant and emphasize the character of the house.

Premium-level landscaping: rare ornamental plants, lounge areas with architectural lighting, and pathways made of fine natural stone. Every detail blends with the architecture of the house and the surrounding nature.

blocks.text: Surroundings and integration of the house

parts.html: The facade and the surrounding grounds were designed with the environment in mind, so the house looks like a natural part of the landscape.

items: Two options to choose from: 3D visualization for both designs.
Material recommendations: help choosing the best option.
Landscape design: a complete project that highlights the style of the house.
